root_cause.compiled_path_behavior: shell_introspection_init prepends the compiled MUTTER_TYPELIB_DIR to GI library search at line231. An absolute system directory can load a second library object despite earlier LD_LIBRARY_PATH selection.
root_cause.missed_by_initial_validation: --version exits while parsing options before shell_introspection_init. Generic Python GI import does not reproduce Shell private library prepending; early maps can precede second-library loading.
root_cause.built_in_fix_path: maybe_add_rpath_introspection_paths is called last and prepends only $ORIGIN-relative executable RPATH/RUNPATH entries to both GI search and library paths. The shipped executable contains this implementation.

change.new_executable: Existing gnome-shell48.7-0+deb13u2 copied into candidate /opt prefix; only ELF RUNPATH metadata adjusted, no GNOME source or SBC algorithm edits.
change.dispatch: Only UID1000 with feedback flag exactly1 executes copied candidate; all other users exec original /usr/bin/gnome-shell.
change.global_dropin: ExecStart uses UID dispatcher; optional %U.env still exists only for1000. Actual original unit argv contained only /usr/bin/gnome-shell.
